title: A Timeline of Jelly Roll & Bunnie Xo’s Relationship
summary: The country star filed for divorce after 10 years of marriage to the podcaster.
contentText:
Jelly Roll and Bunnie Xo have been through a lot together, from shared humble beginnings to becoming one of country music’s most beloved couples and then calling it quits after nearly 10 years of marriage in 2026.

The singer and Dumb Blonde host first crossed paths when he was still pursuing a hip-hop career, and she was making her living as a sex worker. Both have been open about struggling with substance abuse and spending time in and out of jail, as well as how they helped each other heal and build healthier, more prosperous lives together. Through their romance, Bunnie also became a mom to Jelly’s daughter from a past relationship, Bailee — over whom the podcaster now shares primary custody with the musician — and a stepmom to his son, Noah.

Fast forward a few years, and Bunnie was by Jelly’s side as he switched over to country music and found breakout success with 2022 singles “Son of a Sinner” and “Need a Favor.” She was also there cheering him on from the audience as he gave his emotional new artist of the year acceptance speech at the 2023 CMA Awards, meanwhile Jelly was always in Bunnie’s corner as she grew her brand, shut down her OnlyFans account in 2023 and expanded her audience through the success of Dumb Blonde and her social media profiles.

With all of that history behind them, it came as a big surprise to fans this week when news broke that the artist had filed for divorce from Bunnie in May 2026, citing “irreconcilable differences” in court documents obtained by Billboard .

So, as people adjust to a world where Jelly and Bunnie are no longer together, keep reading to see a timeline of their relationship below.
